review_description: David is the real deal. He does the design, the quote and the installation. He explained his recommendations much better than others that quoted. We talked to quite a few.We were very confident in giving him the job. We were even happier with the job he did.Extremely professional and nice guy. We got a great system suited to our needs at a price considerably lower than competitive quotes.
I found the whole process easy. David turned up when he said he would for the quote and installation and the work was high quality/

We recently had solar panels, a battery, and an inverter installed by Dave at Killawatts, and we couldn’t be happier with the experience. Our house is older, so the installation came with some challenges, but Dave handled everything with incredible skill and professionalism.Not only did he navigate the tricky setup seamlessly, but he also worked through some seriously hot and soupy conditions without cutting corners or compromising on quality. His attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and overall work ethic were top-notch.If you’re looking for a reliable, knowledgeable, and professional solar installer, Dave at Killawatts is the guy to call.Highly recommend!

The quote was supplied promptly and followed by an onsite visit to answer any questions and to ensure there was nothing concerning about the house that would impact the quote or installation. This was done without pressuring me into making rapid decisions. He took into consideration my future plans such as switching from gas to electric hot water and purchase of an EV.Solar panels, inverter and battery were installed. The installation went smoothly and, at my request, the meter box was upgraded. He was punctual and the work site was kept tidy.David was polite and communicated well. He ensured that I understood the system at completion of work and that I knew how to contact him if there were any issues. I highly recommend him and would happily recommend him to family and friends.

David from Killawatts has been excellent to deal with. He provided quotes very promptly and was happy to answer questions and work with us to refine the system. He was quick with all communications.We had panels, inverter and battery supplied and installed.The system was being added during a renovation & he fitted in with what worked with the builder’s schedule. David came when he said he would & was very reliable.His work was very neat, and he kept the site tidy. There were a few things that needed sorting out with the existing meter box and he was happy to sort them out.The hand over of the system was clear and he helped us get set up on the monitoring app etc.Can’t recommend Killawatts highly enough.

The whole process was easy from the quote to commissioning. David was easy to communicate with and did a thorough job. He took the time to work out the best orientations and placement of panels on the south facing skillion roof. He answered questions and gave advice, but didnt push to upsell like some installers do. I’m very pleased with the result.

David was prompt in quoting and patiently answered our questions over the phone, as well as in person and at the home, where he also inspected the tile roof to confirm the details of installation and that there would be no variation to the original quotation.  He kept us informed of the steps required in installation, and arrived on each of the four days required for installation at pre-agreed times.  He carefully explained any alternatives that we raised for the system quoted, with a focus on achieving value for money for us.

Dave was a consummate professional who guided us through the installation process with clear direction, he went above and beyond by coming back after the job to install our inverter cover as this came after the installation of the main system. Would not hesitate to recommend him to friends and family.

David and his team from Killawatt have been  fantastic to deal with from out initial enquiry  to the complete install.David explained everything  that was required and answered all our questions in regards to our electrical solar needs.David and his team were punctual, tidy  and  completed the installation  in a timely  manner.Would highly  recommend  ?

David knows his stuff. He kept it simple and was straightfoward in his approach. Is a local business which was our preference.Was able to accommodate our request for black panels and his apprentice did a great job in the roof space in challenging conditions, it was very warm.System delivered promptly and with no bother. Would recommend.

Killawatts was responsive, and provided a great solar system that was in budget. They helped with the removal of the existing system, the roof was made good prior to installing the new system, and did all leg work to set us up with endeavour energy. We're very happy, and we highly recommend Killawatts.

David from KillaWatts provided extensive consultation, sound advice on the most appropriate system and seemless installation of our new system. He was patient with our questions, very pragmatic and honest in his advice and very reliable in the delivery and installation.Definitely would recommend David, especially to those who need advice and are not that familiar with solar options.
David was very professional. Gave good advice, communicated well. His price was competitive and he stuck to his quote. Thanks for the good work David.

We just had Killawatt Solar install a 10kw solar system at our home and couldn’t fault anything! David made the whole process super simple to choose the most suitable system size for our electric car. Fantastic communication, high quality job with great attention to detail and just easy to deal with. If anyone is going through the difficult process of finding a reputable Solar installer, make sure and call David!!

David from KillaWatts was a pleasure to deal with,  He was responsive, quick and very professional.  He was on site when he said he would be on site and was great with communication, keeping us informed throughout the whole process.  His work was tidy and professional.  I recommend KillaWatts Solar Power if you are in the market to install solar panels.
KillaWatts David had been recommend by two different friends . Very professional no hassles would be happy to recommend him to anyone.

KillaWatts are excellent to deal with. The process from start to finish was most professional and I can not fault the Job.David was a pleasure to deal with. The quoted price was the end price.Kept us informed and ensured we understood the process right to the end.

The quoting process was excellent.  David was patient and thorough in his responses to detailed questions.  He is highly professional, articulate and thoughtful in his approach and straightforward to deal with.  Installation went smoothly.  (However, we are still resolving an issue with provision of information on consumption etc. from Goodwe's HomeKit which David is in the process of addressing.)

Really happy with KillaWatts, the only installers who actually looked on our roof before quoting and making us feel confident that they were quoting us on a system that was suited to our roof. They were professional and a pleasure to work with and they quoted and installed a system that suited us rather than trying to sell us on a specific brand or size they wanted as seemed to be the case with some other providers.
he gave a detailed quote with optionshe actually got up on the roofthe installation went well tidy and was all set it uponce the new meter was installed  he came and set  it all up

David at Killawatts was very professional and accomodating.  He discussed options during the quote and was accomodating to our requests.  Dave obviously take great pride in his work, taking time to do a thorough job. I've inspected a lot of the work in the roof space and it is clean and professionally done.  We've had the system running for 8 months now with no problems and great results. The price wasn't the cheapest (or the most expensive) but solar is a long term investment and Killawatts provided a good value service that I have confidence in for future returns.
Prompt and tidy installation with good advice and help afterwards
Efficient, friendly, responsive and gave good advice.  David did what he said he would and delivered on time.The price included optimizers and WiFi monitoring via phone app. 330kw Trina panels.

David was punctual, polite and tidy.He was very helpful and answered all our questions.When he quoted us,he actually got on the roof and measured to check it would fit. (Unlike the other 2 quotes we got)

Dave from Killawatts was a pleasure to have around our house doing the installation, he has great communication prior and post installation. He went out of his way to answer any and all questions. Would highly recommend.

Friendly and informative electrician, provided a tailored quote for our installation request. Was very happy to answer any questions during the quoting phase and throughout installation. Competitive pricing and using quality materials and parts. Honest and up front about different options for installation, and you could tell he really knew what he was talking about. Not pushy or salesperson attitude, genuinely interested in getting the right products and installation for us at a good price.Installation was a simple and painless process over a couple of days. Time-frames provided were accurate and turned up when he said he would. Very neat and tidy installation on both the roof panels and inverter. Assisted with forms and information to arrange smart meter installation. Provided all information via text and email in a timely and professional manner.Highly recommended for solar installation.

David did an amazing job in our solar installation. He was diligent, reliable and respectful of our property. He communicated well and was very honest and clear in explaining how the system would work both before and after the job was completed.He showed up when he said he would, was careful and polite and finished the job in the time frame promised. It was quite hot weather during our service and yet he still did a complicated job on a hot and difficult day. He explained clearly how to organise the grid connection and helped me see how the inverter would work. I would highly recommend him to anyone considering a solar installation, I am so glad I didnâ€™t use anyone else.

Was very happy with my interactions with David prior to and during the installation of our 9kw system. During the sales/quoting process he was knowlegable without the sales patter of some of the other companies. He communicated well and was on time when visiting site to confirm quote. The quote was competitive. David started the installation when he said he would, and finished it in a timely manner, with comprehensive handover information/documentation provided. David worked tidily and safely. System was installed approx 1 month after first request put through solarquotes, which I thought was a good result as well.Would have no hesitation in recommending David.
David is a very nice person who has a very diligent method of working. He completed the job on time and to budget and provided some good advice. I have no hesitation in recommending him.

Well worth calling Dave if you are looking at getting solar. Will give straight advice about what is best for you, and takes the time to explain things well. We had him install a 9.9kW system, and couldnt be happier. Really professional approach and friendly as well.

David communicated clearly during the quoting process and the price was competitive with the 2 other quotes we got. The installation took place at the agreed time. We did have a problem with incompatibility between our modem and the inverter which meant that we couldn't monitor our system right away but David liaised with the manufacturer of the inverter until this problem was remedied.We're very happy with how much solar power we generate, how low our electricity bills are and that we can monitor the power we generate on our computers and phones.
Solar Quotes made it all easy.  All three quotes were competitive.  Really happy with our choice.
David was prompt, reliable, knowledgeable and helpful. He was polite and his charges were reasonable. Would recommend him to anyone looking for solar power.
We were extremely impressed with Dave, he explained all about the system he was installing.

David from Sparky Solar & Electrical (now known as Killawatts) was great, his quote was competitive and professional unlike some of the other suppliers.  His workmanship was second to none (Iâ€™m a retired engineer).We live in a retirement village which means that our power meters are housed in a separate meter room.  The problem we had was that Origin (and probably other suppliers) would not change our meter because it required the power to be disconnected to other homes in the village.  This meant that we had to find a Level 2 Electrician to change the meter connections before Origin would change the meter.  This delayed our solar installation by at least 3 months and it cost us an extra $1,200.David from Sparky Solar & Electrical alerted us to these problems before we placed an order for the solar system.  I hate to think what would have happened if we had gone with one of the other companies who were pushing us to sign up without a full site inspection.

We were very impressed with David from Sparky Solar and Electrical.  He came to the house before quoting, and explained the various options clearly. The quote was reasonable and about what we were expecting to pay. The work was completed within a couple of weeks, and his standard of workmanship was excellent.  I would recommend this service.

While I have just had the system installed I am unable to determine the full effect of the system on my power bill as I am waiting for the smart meter to be supplied by my electricity supplier. However I have run some tests on the system and the results show that I should get a significent reduction in my power bill.David from Sparky Solar and Electrical was very professional from the the first conversations I had with him right through to the hand over of the finished installation. I would have no hesitation recommending Sparky Solar and Electrical as a supplier.

We were extremely impressed with Dave, he was very knowledgeable about the system he was selling. Dave explained everything about the system we had installed, an installation was done in the time frame he told us. We would recommend Dave without any hesitation to other buyers.
Waiting for a smart meter installation to get it going

David is a local guy which really sold it for me due to the fact that if something goes wrong he will be the coming to fix it not some sub contractor. Also David was the only solar quote that actually got on the roof and did all the measurements and quoted what I could actually fit on my roof. Very easy to deal with with communication outstanding. The work was started on the day he said and completed within 3 days. He explained everything I needed to know and made me very comfortable with the decisions I made. Would recommend to anyone.
Dave was friendly, helpful, knowledgeable, prompt and efficient, well organised and set up and had great customer service-highly recommend him

David is an excellent operator who is honest, professional and provides excellent information. On installation - great workmanship/ tradesmanship.  Everything went according to plan.  Excellent product, excellent service, and excellent price. ...Highly recommend....Very happy customers...

David Russin has to be the most informative, patient and helpful person I have ever met.  He had the time to explain to me every detail of what he was doing.  Nothing was a problem for him.  He was on time every time and if he couldn't make it he would ring me.  I would recommend David to anyone as he was the best out of all the quoters :-)
Dave made the whole installation a no fuss process. Turned up on time, left no mess and carried out the works with little impact on our daily life.

We are still awaiting our new meter from Origon but David Russin guided through  the quote and install experience with a great deal of care and follow up info. We have been very happy with the whole process to date. A lot of others immediately google your roof etc but David was quite quick to turn up and inspect and talk in person

David from Sparky Solar & Electrical was the only one of 6 installers I contacted who actually turned up and physically inspected and measured my site for a quote rather than google map overly optimistic estimates from others. This allowed for real time discussion on available options and I am very happy with my installed system. David was realistic with time frames and installation ran smoothly and very neatly. No hassles at all.
Dave was an excellent installer in every respect

Sparky were so professional in their advice and customer service, they have done other electrical works for me and I would be happy to refer them to friends and family alike. Information provided was prior installation and fully followed up with information and training on the online system for checking usage data.

David was knowledgable, punctual, thorough, neat, and very pleasant (and great with our dogs).  He kept us informed of what he was doing via email or SMS.  David also identified a problem with my old solar array switch and replaced it.In fact I have recommended the company to my daughter who will also be getting a system from them.

I contacted Dave from Sparky Solar & Electrical and told him I was initially after some advice regarding our old, 2kW, system. Dave was happy to assist and prompt in getting to my home. After initial discussions Dave inspected our old system and told us it was best to replace the entire system with a new 5kW rather than adding 3kW. We then went up on the roof and Dave showed me the many problems with our old system. After some more discussion Dave offered a 2 step price: 1 for the new solar and the 2nd for other work we required. We agreed on the spot and Dave was back within a  couple of weeks to carry out the work.All work was completed on time and within the original quote.We would have no hesitation in recommending Sparky Solar & Electrical as a very professional enterprise. In fact, I believe it was on our recommendation that our neighbours selected Dave to install their new 6kW system
David was up front and very helpful when discussing the solar systemPrompt on the job and demonstrated a professional approach through all aspects of the projectHighly recommend
